outcome: Frequency and rate of cesarean section (CS)
cohort: The study included 173 pregnant females who met the selection criteria and were enrolled after providing informed consent.
finding: The study found an overall cesarean section (CS) rate of 44.1%, with Robson's Group 5 (42.8%), Group 3 (12.7%), and Group 10 (11%) being the primary contributors.
mod_finding: The majority of females who had a cesarean section were classified in Robson's Groups 5, 3, and 10, with key contributing factors identified as prior CS scars, fetal distress, failed induction, and meconium-stained liquor.
